## 🛠️ **EXECUTION PLAN: STAGING ENVIRONMENT (PRE-PRODUCTION)**

### 🔴 **Phase 1: High-Risk Tests (Immediate Escalation if Failed)**
| Test Case | Purpose | Success Criteria |
|----------|--------|------------------|
| **TC-PII-04** | Validate SSN hashing consistency (with formatting variants) | Same output for `123-45-6789`, `123456789`, `123 45 6789` |
| **TC-PII-05** | Validate email hashing (case-insensitive, normalized) | `User@Example.com` ≡ `user@example.com` → same SHA-256 |

> 🚨 **Escalation Protocol**: If either fails → **immediate alert to CISO + incident response team**. System must be quarantined until root cause resolved.

---

### 🟡 **Phase 2: Core Hashing Validation**
| Test Case | Input Type | Verification Method |
|----------|------------|---------------------|
| TC-PII-01 | SSN (cleaned) | Compare against expected SHA-256 |
| TC-PII-02 | Email (lowercased, stripped) | Confirm normalization before hashing |
| TC-PII-03 | Account Number (numeric only) | Ensure no whitespace/dash interference |

> ✅ All use **pre-defined normalization rules**:
> - Remove non-digit chars from SSN/account numbers
> - Convert emails to lowercase
> - Strip leading/trailing spaces

---

### 🟢 **Phase 3: Access Control & Observability**
| Test Case | Objective | Tool Used |
|----------|-----------|----------|
| TC-PII-06 | Verify JWT scope check | Postman / curl + authz middleware logs |
| TC-PII-07 | Confirm audit log capture | Query PostgreSQL audit table via `pgAudit` |
| TC-PII-08 | Validate full audit context (IP, user_id, timestamp) | Log analysis script (Python + regex) |

> ✅ Audit log fields required:  
> `timestamp`, `user_id`, `ip_address`, `action`, `resource`, `status`, `jwt_scope`

---

### 🔐 **Phase 4: Transport Security (Final Layer)**
| Test Case | Objective | Tool Used |
|----------|-----------|----------|
| TC-PII-09 | Enforce TLS 1.3 only | `nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers` + Wireshark trace |

> ✅ Must reject any connection using TLS 1.0–1.2  
> ✅ Only allow ciphers from approved list (e.g., `TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384`, `TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256`)
